description:
About Mindly


Mindly is an international product company — a marketplace for psychologists and their clients. We have over 1,000,000 clients in more than 40 countries worldwide, with a primary focus on Tier-1 markets. Mindly is one of the fastest-growing companies in the HealthTech sector globally. Our goal is to help people live healthy, happy, and fulfilling lives. We are growing extremely fast and are already profitable! This puts our company in the top 1% of the fastest-growing profitable tech companies in the world! You can read more about us in this article.

Your responsibilities:

  • Draft, review and negotiate B2B agreements with partners, vendors and contractors, and maintain a library of contract templates the team can reuse

  • Review new features and product launches from a legal perspective, flag risks early and suggest practical solutions that keep the product moving

  • Own and keep up to date our Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy and other user-facing and internal policies across multiple jurisdictions

  • Support GDPR and data protection compliance, especially for the sensitive data typical of a mental health platform, and track regulatory changes in our key markets

  • Maintain corporate documentation, prepare legal documents for board meetings, and work with external legal advisors, accountants and auditors (incl. KPMG) on legal and financial compliance

  • Work closely with the Product, Finance and Operations teams on day-to-day legal questions, explaining legal risks in plain language

Your skills:

  • 1–2+ years of experience in Corporate, Commercial or IT Law

  • Experience in a product / tech company or startup

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law

  • Hands-on experience drafting and reviewing commercial contracts

  • Working knowledge of GDPR and privacy regulations

  • A business-oriented mindset: you look for solutions, not just risks

  • High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment

  • Upper-Intermediate (B2) English or higher

Nice to have:

  • Experience with international companies and multi-jurisdiction compliance

  • Experience at a Big Four or similar consulting firm

  • Exposure to banking regulation, payments or financial compliance

  • Experience with HealthTech or other sensitive personal data

How we get things done?
 Fully remote, but ideally you’re in the CET or EET time zone.

How do we unwind?
 We offer our team 20 days of paid vacation (we’re flexible with days off :))

What do we offer?

  • A fast-growing product company where you are a key part of our success

  • Competitive salary

  • Therapy on Mindly

  • A strong team of A-players

Candidate journey:

  • Screening interview

  • Skill-based interview

  • Interview with CEO

  • Offer 🎉

Our values:

  • Honesty and transparency: always tell the truth, no matter what it is

  • Empathy and understanding: treat others the way you want to be treated
